searchText: Your best but is to reach out to one of the client teams. Geth, Nethermind, Erigon, Besu. I weakly recommend Nethermind as it is a minority client (we need more people running it) and it has a relatively low-disk-space mode (compared to Erigon/Geth). Thank you
